titleEn: A Nap for the Baby Cousin

pages.text: After lunch, the baby cousin took a nap. Today, though, those eyes were wide awake.
Lulu spread a blanket. "Today I will try putting the baby to sleep."
Aunt Rosa rushed over with a fan. "Babies must be cool to sleep!" She fanned in big swoops.
She sang a lullaby too. Very, very loudly.
The baby's eyes widened more. Little feet kicked along to Aunt Rosa's voice.
"Then this will do it!" Aunt Rosa shook a rattle hard.
The baby laughed and sat up. All sleepiness was gone.
Lulu lay beside the baby and shut both eyes, even pretending to snore.
The baby lay down too. Slowly, the eyes closed.
The baby breathed softly in sleep. Beside the baby, Aunt Rosa was already snoring!
